Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Interface KristenHttpClientEventHandler

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    KristenHttpClientEventAdapter
    public interface KristenHttpClientEventHandler
    Receives events generated by a KristenHttpClient.

    Applications may implement this interface to receive notifications about HTTP client connections, synchronous and asynchronous agent sends, and received replies.

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed
    See Also:
    KristenHttpClient, KristenHttpClientEventAdapter
